name: Kusuhara Hiroki
source:
Ever since losing his childhood friend in a traffic accident, he has been experiencing uncontrollable suicidal tendencies. However, his attempts have always ended in failure. 
"Why couldn't I save Sorano?" The thought constantly hounds him.
"If it really was your fault that Sorano died, then you can gladly go after her, can't you?" So says Amamiya, as he suggest he speak with Sorano's memories.
And so, Kusuhara and Amamiya set off, towards the Connect Center, but--
